LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DETERMINERS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are articles used with nouns?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify definite and indefinite articles in a written text for effective communication,
2. use definite and indefinite articles in sentences for effective communication,
3. acknowledge the use of articles in oral and written contexts for self- expression. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners.
2. Explain Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read aloud the articles a, an and the with peers,
4. Show that you can: identify definite and indefinite articles in a written text for effective communication,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How are articles used with nouns?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read aloud the articles a, an and the with peers,
2. Collaborate to match definite and indefinite articles with a list of nouns,
3. Complete blanks in sentences using correct articles,
4. Construct sentences with peers using definite and indefinite articles,
